blocks.text: Amides mein functional group -CONH2 hota hai. Carboxylic acids se ban sakne ki wajah se inhein kabhi acid amides kehte hain. Yeh acyl chlorides ko kamre ke darje par ammonia ya primary amines se react kara kar banaye jate hain, jis se hydrogen chloride ka safaid dhuan nikalta hai:

items: CH3COCl + NH3 -> CH3CONH2 + HCl (ethanamide); C6H5COCl + NH3 -> C6H5CONH2 + HCl (benzamide).
CH3COCl + CH3CH2NH2 -> CH3CONHCH2CH3 + HCl (N-ethylethanamide); CH3COCl + C6H5NH2 -> CH3CONHC6H5 + HCl (N-phenylethanamide).

Banne wala HCl ammonia ya amine ke aik aur molecule se react kar ke namak banata hai (NH3 + HCl -> NH4+ Cl-; RNH2 + HCl -> RNH3+ Cl-), is liye reaction mukammal karne ko ammonia ya amine zyada use hoti hai.

blocks.title: Tabeei khasiyatein
blocks.text: Methanamide, jo maaye hai, ke siwa sab amides tez pighalne ke darjon wale thos hain, aur molecules ke darmiyan mazboot hydrogen bonding ki wajah se in ke ubalne ke darje kaafi oonche hain. N-substituted amides mein alkyl substituents barhne se pighalne aur ubalne ke darje ghat'te hain, kyunke hydrogen bonding ke liye N-H hydrogens kam hote hain.

Amides aliphatic amines se kaheen kamzor bases hain; amines ke baraks yeh paani mein neutral mehlool banate hain. In mein resonance hai: nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl group ke oxygen ki taraf delocalised hota hai (R-CO-NH2 <-> R-C(O-)=NH2+), jis se nitrogen ke electrons kam dastiyab hote aur basicity ghat'ti hai. Carbon aur nitrogen ke darmiyan juzwi double bond ki khasiyat amide ke C-N bond (132 pm) ko aam C-N single bond (147 pm) se chhota bhi karti hai.

Amides sab se kam reactive tezaab derivatives hain, kyunke carbonyl oxygen par delocalised nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl carbon ka juzwi musbat charge (electrophilic taqat) kam karta hai. In ke reactions sust hain aur lambi garmi ya catalyst (tezaab ya base) chahte hain.

items: Tezaabi hydrolysis se carboxylic acid aur ammonium namak: CH3CONH2 + H2O + HCl -> CH3COOH + NH4Cl.
Base ki madad se hydrolysis se tezaab ka namak aur ammonia: CH3CONH2 + NaOH -> CH3COONa + NH3; azad tezaab halke HCl se milta hai: CH3COONa + HCl -> CH3COOH + NaCl.
Khushk ethoxyethane (ether) mein lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III) se reduction primary amines deti hai: CH3CONH2 + 4[H] -> CH3CH2NH2 + H2O; C6H5CONH2 + 4[H] -> C6H5CH2NH2 + H2O (phenylmethanamine).

blocks.alt: Oopar: acyl chlorides se ethanamide, benzamide, N-ethylethanamide aur N-phenylethanamide banane ke chaar mua'adlat. Beech baen: R-CO-NH2, curly teer N ka lone pair C ki taraf aur C=O ke electrons O par le jate, R-C(O-)=NH2+ banta. Beech daen: amide ka C-N 132 pm, amine ka C-N 147 pm. Neeche: ethanamide ki tezaabi aur alkaline hydrolysis aur LiAlH4 se ethanamine mein reduction.
blocks.caption: Amides banana, un ki kam basicity aur reactions (kitab ke mua'adlon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Amides tab bante hain jab ammonia ya amine acyl chloride par hamla kare. Amide mein nitrogen ka lone pair C=O group ke saath bata hota hai: is se amides basic ki bajaye neutral hote, C-N bond chhota hota, aur carbonyl carbon par hamla mushkil hota hai, is liye amide ke reactions sust hain.

blocks.prompt: Amides amines se kaheen kamzor bases kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Amide ke nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl oxygen par delocalised hai, is liye proton lene ke liye dastiyab nahi.

items: Acyl chlorides + NH3 ya amines (zyada, kamre ka darja) se amides.
Delocalised N lone pair: neutral, C-N 132 pm, sab se kam reactive tezaab derivative.
Hydrolysis (tezaab: RCOOH + NH4Cl; base: RCOONa + NH3); LiAlH4 amines mein reduce karta.
